name: Saal Digital Professional Line, 30x21 cm landscape
source: Measured from the publisher's InDesign template, exported as 'raw format incl. bleed, no marks' (not from the downloadable proof-sheet PDFs, which carry visible marks and no TrimBox).
notes: All boxes in PDF points, [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Interior: one PDF page per double-page spread, 3 mm bleed all around. Cover: 20 mm extra on the left (spine/wrap allowance), 3 mm elsewhere. The bleed box is the full media box.
